items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1957-06-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you ever know Bill Johnson and Dink Johnson? ... [INTERVIEWEE] R-E-D-O-M. Reedom. Uh-huh.

ctx.x: Tells here they paid, what was it, 85 or $80 to each member then of the band. Nice picture. That's a nice old contract.
What do they call themselves, the New Orleans Jazz Band, Bill, isn't that in the first part?
That's right, that's why there's a book in that book there, New Orleans.
